label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast Dec 19

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. Getting our christmas breakfast together and we'd like to come to your place same as always. Can we get the back room Saturday Dec 19 at 7am? If the 19th is no good would the 12th work instead? Hoping for the 19th but let me know what you got before we tell everybody its settled.

Dwayne sent me the list and right now its 24 counting Earl and his wife Carol. Thats 19 drivers, 3 from the shop and those two. I'll be the one to get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you wanted last year, so you aren't making food for people that don't show up. Would separate checks be alright again? That worked good for us.

Can we do the same breakfast as last year, the big pans of eggs and home fries and biscuits and gravy, with everybody ordering there own meat off the menu? The $11 a head was fair and if its gone up a little thats fine, just let me know what it is now so I can tell the guys. Also is the bottomless coffee still part of it?

Couple things on the food and getting everybody in. Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you have that would work without eggs? Let me know what you can do for her and if thats a different price. Lonnie is on a walker since his hip and he needs to come in without the steps. Can we use that side door for him, and will it be unlocked that early? If he needs to come around somewhere different let me know and I'll make sure he knows where to go.

This year we want to do a little something for Earl too, but please keep this part quiet. He don't know anything about it. His last day driving is Dec 18, the day before breakfast, and he's been at it 31 years. Carol says a big speech would embarrass him so we aren't looking to make a big production, just something from the guys to mark it.

Would it be alright if we brought a cake from Sugarcreek, or could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls and we'd put a candle in one for him? Your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake anyhow and Earl loves them. I got a price from Sugarcreek but haven't ordered anything. I'd rather hear what you think and what the rolls would cost before we decide. If we go with yours could we keep them back til everybody is sitting down so he don't catch on right away?

One other thing, would you be able to have a backup coffee pot ready just in case that urn acts up again? I remember it quit about 8:15 last year and I know you felt bad. No hard feelings about it, things break, just figured I'd ask while we're getting everything lined up. You said you'd have a backup next time so thats probably already covered.

Thanks Rhonda, we always enjoy coming in there. Let me know about the date and the rest when you get a chance.

Gary
